column7: security.enable_file_permission_check defaults to true (ADR-112) and a FRESH install (no database, or no users) is enforced from its first start: a world-readable key file refuses to start. Only an upgraded deployment (users already exist) without the adr112.file_permission_check.enforced system_metadata marker gets grace-period warnings, and the first clean boot writes the marker so the grace period never comes back (TestRecordADR112EnforcedIfClean_Ratchet). Any error deciding fails closed (TestADR112UpgradeGrace_Decision)
